opening_summary: Darryl Anka discusses a major timeline converging around 2027 involving extraterrestrial disclosure. According to Bashar and other psychic mediums, humanity will learn that secret contact with ETs has been ongoing for decades across scientific, governmental, and medical projects. Rather than aliens suddenly arriving, the revelation concerns decades-long collaboration already underway. Anka explains he is writing a book exploring potential societal reactions to full disclosure, emphasizing psychological preparation for this paradigm-shifting event. He notes that while Western culture finds this revelation novel, indigenous cultures and non-Western civilizations have documented ET contact for millennia.
